title: Homecoming and Semester
author: August Delacroix
blurb: Ada Pemberton, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
